terms.definition: A way energy is held: kinetic, gravitational potential, elastic potential, thermal, chemical, magnetic, electrostatic or nuclear.
terms.examiner: Energy is transferred between stores by heating, work done by forces or electrical work.

terms.definition: An object or group of objects.
terms.examiner: When a system changes, energy is transferred between its stores.

terms.definition: Energy a moving object has: Eₖ = ½ m v².
Energy gained by raising an object: Eₚ = m g h.
Energy stored in a stretched spring: Eₑ = ½ k e².
terms.examiner: Given on the equation sheet; valid only up to the limit of proportionality.

terms.definition: A system where no energy enters or leaves, so the total energy stays the same.
